name: cooking_pot_side
what: the side wall of a round black-iron cooking pot, filling the face: dark iron (the darkest shade of its own grey, never pure black) with a soft vertical highlight left of centre, a thick bright rolled rim as a 2 px band across row 12 to 14, a small iron handle ring on each side just below the rim near columns 6 and 25, a few rivets, the bottom rows a little darker. (The game shows only part of this texture on its box: the middle 24 px wide (columns 4 to 28) and the bottom 20 px (rows 12 to 32), so the rim must sit along row 12. Draw the whole 32 x 32 so that part reads right; what lies outside it is the same material, unimportant.)

name: cooking_pot_top
what: a cooking pot seen from straight above: a thick round dark-iron rim, and inside it a thick orange-brown stew with chunks of meat, carrot and greens and a soft glint. (The game shows only part of this texture on its box: only the middle 24 x 24 px (columns 4 to 28, rows 4 to 28), so the rim's outer edge touches that square's edges and the stew fills its middle. Draw the whole 32 x 32 so that part reads right; what lies outside it is the same material, unimportant.)

name: campfire_top
what: a campfire seen from straight above, filling the face edge to edge: a ring of grey stones round the border, crossed split oak logs inside, glowing orange embers and a bright yellow-white fire core in the middle, grey ash between the logs (this whole face shows)

name: campfire_side
what: the side of a low campfire: a row of grey stones along the very bottom (rows 26 to 32), two crossed split oak log ends with bark and pale cut rings above them (rows 19 to 26), and small orange-yellow flame tips along rows 18 to 20; above row 18, dark smoky air. (The game shows only part of this texture on its box: only the bottom 14 px (rows 18 to 32) across the full width, so stones, logs and flame tips must all fit in those rows. Draw the whole 32 x 32 so that part reads right; what lies outside it is the same material, unimportant.)

name: drying_rack
what: a drying rack frame seen from the side, a see-through cutout: two upright oak sticks 2-3 px thick at the left and right edges, two horizontal poles across (one along row 6, one along row 18), and three or four strips of dark red-brown drying meat hanging from the top pole, with clear see-through gaps everywhere else; nothing above row 4. (The game shows only part of this texture on its box: everything below the top 4 px (rows 4 to 32), on all six sides of a box 14 px tall. Draw the whole 32 x 32 so that part reads right; what lies outside it is the same material, unimportant.)
